title: Better Mine Rebirth
description: A pack of mods that make minecraft better using my custom texture pack.
body:
![Better Mine Rebirth update 0.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5562e19e5de635bf49d54053f8157faaaa9fd3a6.png)

### 
---
### 📋 About
Better Mine Rebirth, it's not just a mods and texture pack. This is how I see the original game. It adds icons to the menu, new elements like in trailers, an improved environment, an improved graphical interface, animations of mobs and players, variations for mobs and new skins for them, as well as new sounds. This is all missing from the original game, and with this modpack, you can safely play on servers and in single-player mode.
### 
---
### 📝Originals
Better Mine Rebirth uses a lot of different textures packs, the main ones are:
- [The main texture pack by Leosha (update to 1.20.1)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YiUBlAFcJtc)
- [Icons (with my custom edit)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/icons)
- [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
- [Detailed Animation Reworked](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/detailed-animations)
- [Fancy: GUI Overhaul (with my custom edit)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fancy-gui-overhaul)
- [Visual Effects+ (some mechanics)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/visual-effects-plus)
- [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/)
- [3D crops Revamped](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/3d-crops)
- [Simple Grass Flowers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-grass-flowers)
- [Enhanced Boss Bars](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/enhanced-boss-bars)
- and more...
